item.title: Show HN: Virtual Panoramas of the Cambrian
item.summary: Hey all! Have been interested in the cambrian, ordovician, and silurian eras for a long time. I've dabbled in 3d art for a long time as well, finally had some time away from work so put some renders together into a little immersive web viewer. Hope you enjoy, would love any feedback you have.
